blocks.zh: 第一部分至第二部分：計畫背景、目標與執行架構
blocks.en: Parts I-II: Program Background, Objectives and Implementation Framework

blocks.zh: 📋 本節學習目標 Learning Objectives
blocks.en: 📋 Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 了解 FDA CPGM 7356.002A 的法規地位、適用範圍與排除品項
blocks.en: Understand the regulatory status, scope and excluded products of FDA CPGM 7356.002A

blocks.zh: 掌握本查廠計畫的主要目標與六大系統查廠策略框架
blocks.en: Grasp the main objectives of this inspection program and its six-system inspection strategy framework

blocks.zh: 辨識各無菌產品類型的 Profile Class 代碼（LVP、SVT、SVS、SVL 等）
blocks.en: Identify the Profile Class codes for the various sterile product types (LVP, SVT, SVS, SVL, etc.)

blocks.zh: 理解查廠規劃的風險優先模型（Risk-Based Prioritization）
blocks.en: Understand the risk-based prioritization model for inspection planning

blocks.zh: 熟悉 EIR、FACTS、OAI 等 FDA 查廠行政系統術語
blocks.en: Become familiar with FDA inspection administration terms such as EIR, FACTS and OAI

blocks.zh: 封面頁：計畫識別 Cover Page — Program Identification
blocks.en: Cover Page: Program Identification

blocks.zh: 📘 計畫識別解讀 — 查廠官員的「工作手冊」
blocks.en: 📘 Program Identification: The Investigator's "Working Manual"

blocks.zh: 什麼是 CPGM（Compliance Program Guidance Manual）？
blocks.en: What is a CPGM (Compliance Program Guidance Manual)?

blocks.zh: CPGM 是 FDA 查廠官員（Investigator/Inspector）在執行查廠任務時所依循的內部工作指引。它不是對藥廠的直接規範，而是告訴 FDA 人員「要查什麼、怎麼查、怎麼報告」。
blocks.en: A CPGM is the internal working guidance that FDA investigators/inspectors follow when carrying out inspection assignments. It is not a direct requirement on manufacturers; it tells FDA personnel what to inspect, how to inspect, and how to report.

blocks.zh: 本計畫 7356.002A 是無菌藥品製程查廠的專屬 CPGM，搭配通用查廠計畫 7356.002 使用。
blocks.en: 7356.002A is the CPGM dedicated to sterile drug process inspections, and is used together with the general inspection program 7356.002.

blocks.zh: 💡 比喻：CPGM 就像查廠官員的「標準作業程序（SOP）」
blocks.en: 💡 Analogy: a CPGM is the investigator's "standard operating procedure (SOP)"

blocks.zh: 正如藥廠的 SOP 告訴員工如何操作設備，CPGM 告訴 FDA Investigator 如何系統性地評估藥廠是否符合 GMP。兩者的邏輯完全相同——程序標準化、結果可比較、文件可稽核。
blocks.en: Just as a company SOP tells employees how to operate equipment, the CPGM tells FDA investigators how to systematically assess whether a manufacturer complies with GMP. The logic is exactly the same: standardized procedures, comparable results, auditable documentation.

blocks.zh: ⚠️ 重要：查廠代碼的意義
blocks.en: ⚠️ Important: what the inspection codes mean

blocks.zh: 56002A（Full Inspection）：完整查廠，覆蓋全部系統
blocks.en: 56002A (Full Inspection): a complete inspection covering all systems

blocks.zh: 56002I（Abbreviated Inspection）：縮短查廠，選定系統查核
blocks.en: 56002I (Abbreviated Inspection): a shortened inspection covering selected systems

blocks.zh: OAI（Official Action Indicated）：缺失嚴重，需採取正式監管行動
blocks.en: OAI (Official Action Indicated): serious deficiencies requiring formal regulatory action

blocks.zh: EIR（Establishment Inspection Report）：每次查廠後的正式書面記錄
blocks.en: EIR (Establishment Inspection Report): the formal written record produced after each inspection

blocks.zh: 關鍵術語
blocks.en: Key Terms

blocks.zh: PAC：Program Assignment Code，計畫分配代碼，用於 FACTS 系統記錄查廠活動
blocks.en: PAC: Program Assignment Code, used to record inspection activity in the FACTS system

blocks.zh: FACTS：FDA 的查廠記錄資料庫系統
blocks.en: FACTS: FDA's inspection records database system

blocks.zh: MARCS-CMS：FDA 監管行動管理系統
blocks.en: MARCS-CMS: FDA's regulatory action management system

blocks.zh: ADE：Adverse Drug Experience，藥物不良事件
blocks.en: ADE: Adverse Drug Experience

blocks.zh: Part I — Background 計畫背景
blocks.en: Part I: Background

blocks.zh: 📘 背景解讀 — 適用範圍與法規層級
blocks.en: 📘 Background: Scope and Regulatory Hierarchy

blocks.zh: 本計畫的雙重定位
blocks.en: The dual role of this program

blocks.zh: 本 CPGM 7356.002A 是無菌製程查廠的專門補充，必須與母計畫 CP 7356.002（一般藥品製造查廠）搭配使用。查廠時，兩份文件同時適用。
blocks.en: CPGM 7356.002A is a dedicated supplement for sterile process inspections and must be used together with its parent program, CP 7356.002 (general drug manufacturing inspections). During an inspection, both documents apply at the same time.

blocks.zh: ⚠️ 指引 vs 法規：關鍵區別
blocks.en: ⚠️ Guidance vs regulation: the key difference

blocks.zh: 2004 Aseptic Processing Guidance（指引）不是法規強制要求。
blocks.en: The 2004 Aseptic Processing Guidance is not a mandatory legal requirement.

blocks.zh: 查廠缺失的法律依據必須來自 21 CFR Part 210 或 21 CFR Part 211（法規強制）。
blocks.en: The legal basis for any inspectional observation must come from 21 CFR Part 210 or 21 CFR Part 211 (legally enforceable regulations).

blocks.zh: 實務意涵：藥廠可以偏離指引，但必須用替代方法達到同等效果，且必須能向查廠官員說明替代方法如何符合 CFR 要求。
blocks.en: Practical implication: a manufacturer may deviate from the guidance, but must use an alternative approach that achieves an equivalent result, and must be able to explain to the investigator how that alternative meets the CFR requirements.

blocks.zh: 💡 CBER 為何排除在外？
blocks.en: 💡 Why is CBER excluded?

blocks.zh: CBER（生物製品評估與研究中心）負責監管疫苗、血液製品、基因療法等。這類產品有其專屬的查廠計畫。本 CPGM 7356.002A 僅涵蓋 CDER（藥物評估與研究中心）監管的無菌藥品，包括小分子藥物和授權生物治療藥品（licensed biologic therapeutics）。
blocks.en: CBER (Center for Biologics Evaluation and Research) regulates vaccines, blood products, gene therapies and similar products, which have their own inspection programs. CPGM 7356.002A covers only sterile drugs regulated by CDER (Center for Drug Evaluation and Research), including small-molecule drugs and licensed biologic therapeutics.

blocks.zh: 🏭 對藥廠的實務啟示
blocks.en: 🏭 Practical Implications for Manufacturers

blocks.zh: 了解 FDA Investigator 的查廠邏輯，有助於 internal audit 的設計
blocks.en: Understanding how FDA investigators think about inspections helps in designing internal audits

blocks.zh: 查廠官員的觀察依據是 21 CFR，不是 Guidance——藥廠答辯時同樣要引用 CFR
blocks.en: Investigators base their observations on 21 CFR, not on guidance; your responses should likewise cite the CFR

blocks.zh: CBER 產品（如疫苗）適用不同的查廠計畫，不在本文件範圍
blocks.en: CBER products (e.g., vaccines) fall under different inspection programs and are outside the scope of this document

blocks.zh: 兩大製程的法規意義
blocks.en: Regulatory significance of the two process types

blocks.zh: FDA 認為無菌加工的污染風險高於最終滅菌，因此對其有更嚴格的查廠要求。
blocks.en: FDA considers the contamination risk of aseptic processing to be higher than that of terminal sterilization, and therefore applies stricter inspection requirements to it.

blocks.zh: Part II — Implementation 執行架構
blocks.en: Part II: Implementation

blocks.zh: 📘 目標解讀 — 查廠的三重目的
blocks.en: 📘 Objectives: The Three Purposes of Inspection

blocks.zh: 查廠目標的優先層次
blocks.en: Priority hierarchy of inspection objectives

blocks.zh: 合規評估：主要目標——確認廠商是否符合 21 CFR 210/211
blocks.en: Compliance assessment: the primary objective, confirming whether the firm complies with 21 CFR 210/211

blocks.zh: 資訊蒐集：識別可改善的製程缺失（不一定構成違規）
blocks.en: Information gathering: identifying process weaknesses that could be improved (not necessarily violations)

blocks.zh: 法規行動：對不合規廠商啟動正式監管措施（Warning Letter、進口警示等）
blocks.en: Regulatory action: initiating formal regulatory measures (Warning Letter, import alert, etc.) against non-compliant firms

blocks.zh: 💡 查廠不只是「找缺失」
blocks.en: 💡 Inspection is not only about "finding deficiencies"

blocks.zh: FDA 查廠的目的包含了解產業現況以制定政策，不僅僅是懲罰不合規廠商。這也是為什麼查廠官員即使在合規廠商也會詳細記錄製程——這些資訊有助於 FDA 了解產業趨勢。
blocks.en: One purpose of FDA inspections is to understand the current state of the industry in order to develop policy, not merely to penalize non-compliant firms. This is why investigators document processes in detail even at compliant firms; the information helps FDA understand industry trends.

blocks.zh: 📘 策略解讀 — 系統式查廠的邏輯
blocks.en: 📘 Strategy: The Logic of Systems-Based Inspection

blocks.zh: 六大系統查廠框架（Six Systems Framework）
blocks.en: Six Systems Framework

blocks.zh: FDA 採用系統式查廠（Systems-Based Inspection）而非逐項清單式查廠。本 CPGM 7356.002A 涵蓋以下六大系統（詳見 Part III）：
blocks.en: FDA uses a systems-based inspection approach rather than an item-by-item checklist approach. CPGM 7356.002A covers the following six systems (see Part III for details):

blocks.zh: 品質系統 Quality System（3.5）
blocks.en: Quality System (3.5)

blocks.zh: 廠房與設備系統 Facilities & Equipment（3.6）
blocks.en: Facilities & Equipment System (3.6)

blocks.zh: 物料系統 Materials System（3.7）
blocks.en: Materials System (3.7)

blocks.zh: 生產系統 Production System（3.8）
blocks.en: Production System (3.8)

blocks.zh: 包裝與標籤系統 Packaging & Labeling（3.9）
blocks.en: Packaging & Labeling System (3.9)

blocks.zh: 實驗室控制系統 Laboratory Control System（3.10）
blocks.en: Laboratory Control System (3.10)

blocks.zh: 💡 系統式查廠的優勢
blocks.en: 💡 Advantages of systems-based inspection

blocks.zh: 傳統逐項清單查廠容易流於表面；系統式查廠要求查廠官員從源頭理解整個系統的控制狀態。例如：查品質系統時，會評估 CAPA、偏差管理、變更管制是否相互連結，而不只是確認文件是否存在。
blocks.en: Traditional item-by-item checklist inspections tend to stay superficial; systems-based inspection requires investigators to understand the state of control of the whole system from its source. For example, when inspecting the quality system, they assess whether CAPA, deviation management and change control are linked to one another, not just whether the documents exist.

blocks.zh: ⚠️ 縮短查廠（Abbreviated Inspection）不等於寬鬆
blocks.en: ⚠️ An Abbreviated Inspection is not a lenient one

blocks.zh: Abbreviated Inspection 並非「走走看看」，而是針對特定系統進行深度查核。District Office 根據廠商合規歷史決定查核哪些系統——若有既往 OAI 記錄，缺失系統必然被重點查核。
blocks.en: An Abbreviated Inspection is not a "walk-through"; it is an in-depth review of specific systems. The District Office decides which systems to cover based on the firm's compliance history; if there is a prior OAI record, the systems where deficiencies were found will certainly be a focus.

blocks.zh: 風險優先查廠模型（Risk-Based Prioritization）
blocks.en: Risk-Based Prioritization Model

blocks.zh: CDER 使用風險評分模型決定查廠優先順序，評估因素包括：
blocks.en: CDER uses a risk-scoring model to set inspection priorities. The factors evaluated include:

blocks.zh: 查廠間隔時間（越久未查，風險越高）
blocks.en: Time since the last inspection (the longer the interval, the higher the risk)

blocks.zh: 既往缺失記錄（OAI 歷史）
blocks.en: Prior deficiency record (OAI history)

blocks.zh: 產品對患者的重要性（essential medicines）
blocks.en: Importance of the product to patients (essential medicines)

blocks.zh: 製程複雜度（無菌加工 > 最終滅菌）
blocks.en: Process complexity (aseptic processing > terminal sterilization)

blocks.zh: 🏭 藥廠準備要點
blocks.en: 🏭 Preparation Points for Manufacturers

blocks.zh: 熟悉六大系統框架，按此架構設計 mock inspection
blocks.en: Become familiar with the six-systems framework and design your mock inspections around it

blocks.zh: 查廠團隊應有微生物學家——確保廠內微生物相關系統（EM、APS、無菌測試）有專人管理
blocks.en: The inspection team should include a microbiologist, ensuring that microbiology-related systems at the site (EM, APS, sterility testing) have a designated owner

blocks.zh: CDER 的風險模型偏向高頻查廠無菌製程，需保持持續性合規，而非「查前突擊準備」
blocks.en: CDER's risk model favors frequent inspection of aseptic processes, so maintain continuous compliance rather than "last-minute preparation before an inspection"

blocks.zh: 📘 Profile Class 解讀 — 產品代碼與查廠差異
blocks.en: 📘 Profile Classes: Product Codes and Inspection Differences

blocks.zh: 💡 生物製劑（SVS）的特殊性
blocks.en: 💡 Special characteristics of biologics (SVS)

blocks.zh: 蛋白質藥物（如抗體、胰島素）無法承受熱滅菌，必須採過濾除菌（0.22 μm 過濾）加上無菌加工。這也是生物製劑工廠必然面對更複雜無菌查廠要求的原因。
blocks.en: Protein drugs (e.g., antibodies, insulin) cannot withstand heat sterilization and must be made by sterile filtration (0.22 μm filter) combined with aseptic processing. This is why biologics manufacturing sites inevitably face more demanding sterile inspection requirements.

blocks.zh: ⚠️ 凍乾產品（SVL）的雙重挑戰
blocks.en: ⚠️ The double challenge of lyophilized products (SVL)

blocks.zh: SVL 產品（凍乾注射劑）需要通過兩個高風險步驟：
blocks.en: SVL products (lyophilized injectables) must pass through two high-risk steps:

blocks.zh: 無菌填充到小瓶（Aseptic Filling）
blocks.en: Aseptic filling into vials (Aseptic Filling)

blocks.zh: 凍乾機內的塞瓶操作（In-Lyophilizer Stoppering）
blocks.en: Stoppering inside the lyophilizer (In-Lyophilizer Stoppering)

blocks.zh: 任何一個步驟出現問題都可能導致整批產品無菌性失敗，是 FDA 查廠時的高風險焦點。
blocks.en: A problem at either step can cause sterility failure of the entire batch, so both are high-risk focus areas during FDA inspections.

blocks.zh: 🏭 確認您廠的 Profile Class
blocks.en: 🏭 Confirm Your Site's Profile Classes

blocks.zh: 確認廠內每個產品線對應的 Profile Class
blocks.en: Confirm the Profile Class for each product line at your site

blocks.zh: 不同 Profile Class 的 APS（培養基模擬試驗）設計需求不同——SVL 需包含塞瓶模擬
blocks.en: APS (media fill) design requirements differ by Profile Class; SVL requires simulation of stoppering

blocks.zh: 查廠官員會根據 Profile Class 調整查廠重點，廠方應按此規劃 quality system 文件
blocks.en: Investigators adjust their inspection focus according to Profile Class, so plan your quality system documentation accordingly

blocks.zh: Profile Class 的重要性
blocks.en: Importance of the Profile Class

blocks.zh: Profile Class 代碼決定查廠的重點方向。製程類型不同，查廠要求也不同：
blocks.en: The Profile Class code determines the focus of the inspection. Different process types carry different inspection requirements:

blocks.zh: 📌 本節重點摘要 Section Summary — Parts I & II
blocks.en: 📌 Section Summary: Parts I & II

blocks.zh: 法規地位：CPGM 7356.002A 是 FDA Investigator 的查廠工作手冊，查廠缺失的法律依據為 21 CFR Parts 210 & 211，非本文件本身
blocks.en: Regulatory status: CPGM 7356.002A is the FDA investigator's inspection working manual; the legal basis for inspectional observations is 21 CFR Parts 210 & 211, not this document itself

blocks.zh: 適用範圍：所有 CDER 監管的無菌藥品（過濾除菌、無菌加工、最終滅菌）；排除 CBER 產品與獸藥
blocks.en: Scope: all CDER-regulated sterile drugs (sterile filtration, aseptic processing, terminal sterilization); CBER products and veterinary drugs are excluded

blocks.zh: 查廠框架：六大系統式查廠（品質、廠房設備、物料、生產、包裝標籤、實驗室控制）
blocks.en: Inspection framework: six-system inspection (quality, facilities and equipment, materials, production, packaging and labeling, laboratory controls)

blocks.zh: 查廠類型：Full Inspection（56002A）或 Abbreviated Inspection（56002I），由 District Office 決定
blocks.en: Inspection types: Full Inspection (56002A) or Abbreviated Inspection (56002I), decided by the District Office

blocks.zh: 風險優先：CDER 依風險模型排定查廠優先順序；無菌製程廠商屬高優先級
blocks.en: Risk prioritization: CDER sets inspection priorities using a risk model; sterile processing firms are high priority

blocks.zh: Profile Class：LVP、SVT、SVS、SVL、CSS 等代碼決定查廠方向；凍乾（SVL）與無菌加工（SVS）屬最高關注類別
blocks.en: Profile Class: codes such as LVP, SVT, SVS, SVL and CSS determine the inspection focus; lyophilized (SVL) and aseptic processing (SVS) products are the highest-concern categories

blocks.zh: 2004 指引：遵循 Aseptic Processing Guidance 視為符合 CGMP，但允許替代方法，前提是符合 21 CFR
blocks.en: 2004 Guidance: following the Aseptic Processing Guidance is considered compliance with CGMP, but alternative approaches are permitted provided they satisfy 21 CFR
